purpose: Descriptive model comparison after three-replicate development ranking; no fidelity winner, final-test or FINALISTS_FROZEN claim.

selection_policy.ranking: Same frozen ascending(-C,-V,conservative known cost plus retained holds,ASCII config_id) over84 planned ordered rows perconfig; missing rows remain0deliveredcorrect/valid.
selection_policy.common_cap: Use personalization cap of global highest-ranked configuration; select up to3 distinct method families at that same cap by the same ranking, at most one config per family. Report fewer than2 as insufficient planned panel, not a substituted config.
selection_policy.rationale: Existing scaling contract requires2–3 methods under a common feasible cap; preserve actual selected configurations instead of retagging saved profiles.
selection_policy.instance_policy: Use predeclared replicate0 only as saved Luna instance for A/B/C; missing rep0 instance stays unavailable, never select a lucky later replica.
selection_policy.timing: Frozen after replica extraction outcomes but before their consumer predictions or comparative scores.
selection_policy.comparison_limit: Choice of common cap is development-selected and conditional; not a global method optimum.

studies.A: all selected configs and controls at3models; joint extraction+consumer, explicit futureSol/Astra dependencies
studies.B: primary config saved exact Luna rep0 profile perresearcher across3consumers
studies.C: primary config S/Lextractor x S/Lconsumer; exact existingA/Bcells referenced once
studies.D: only evaluator source-defined answer-known subset/withholding receipt if supplied; fixed raw evidence, no profile. Missing receipt => explicit unavailable, no invented label/subset.

reference_rule: All *_ref or path/sha256 objects bind exact bytes; final receipt contains no placeholder strings. Mapping arrays cover both researchers, including unavailable original instances. Compiler may hash score receipt bytes without opening scores; root supplies selected IDs. Separate runtime and compiler provenance.
